audience.programmeDescription: This 2026–2027 Archaeology curriculum is taught through ACASA, the collaboration between UvA and VU Amsterdam. Students study material remains, practise excavation in two field schools, and complete a thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers archaeology, heritage, and spatial analysis courses. A full comparison would require a sequence that connects those subjects to supervised excavation, finds processing and archaeological research.

componentNotes.arch-110120016y: Examine and classify objects using archaeological reference collections.
componentNotes.arch-110121136y: Study past landscapes, food economies and relationships between people and the environment.
componentNotes.arch-110121146y: Practise excavation, recording and finds processing in the first year.
componentNotes.arch-110221036y: Apply digital and quantitative methods to archaeological evidence.
componentNotes.arch-110221116y: Identify and interpret archaeological ceramics using collections and excavation material.
componentNotes.arch-110221216y: Build on Field School 1, which must be completed before entry.
componentNotes.arch-110326016y: Work from excavation evidence toward a research report suitable for publication.
